name: naiveReverse
type: def naiveReverse {A : Type} : List A → CostM ℕ (List A) | [] => pure [] | a :: as => do ✓[as.length + 1] do let rest ← naiveReverse as pure (rest ++ [a]) /-- Cumulative `++` allocation is quadratic in input length. -/

name: naiveReverse_cost_le
type: theorem naiveReverse_cost_le {A : Type} (l : List A) : (naiveReverse l).cost ≤ l.length * l.length
